sources.quote: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 now include the full 1M context window at standard pricing on the Claude Platform. Standard pricing applies across the full window — $5/$25 per million tokens for Opus 4.6 and $3/$15 for Sonnet 4.6.
sources.supports: Anthropic's March 13 announcement says Sonnet 4.6's full 1M window moved to standard pricing; this confirms removal of the long-context premium on that day.

sources.quote: Pricing remains the same as Sonnet 4.5, starting at $3/$15 per million tokens.
sources.supports: At launch on February 17, Anthropic described Sonnet 4.6 pricing as the same as Sonnet 4.5 and gave $3/$15 as the starting rate, consistent with a long-context premium before the March 13 announcement.

notes: Anthropic announced on March 13, 2026 that standard $3/$15 pricing applied across Sonnet 4.6's full 1M context window, removing the long-context premium reflected in the earlier tiered price. The announcement specifies a calendar date but no time or timezone; Internet Archive CDX requests timed out, so no snapshot bracket is available.
